Cycling Road will be closed on the 7th for inspection

Vermilion City has been awarded first place on the
Most Livable Cities list, making this the fourth
consecutive year that our city has received this honor.

The city scored highly due to its abundance of natural
beauty, which has been preserved despite ongoing
urban development, as well as its many sightseeing
spots. The gorgeous view of the harbor at night was
cited as one of the main deciding factors.

As you all know, Cerulean Cave was recently declared
off-limits to the public. However, a recent survey
discovered a crack in the southern rock wall that
makes it possible to enter the cave.

We ask that nearby residents do not enter the cave
for any reason. In addition, please contact the
Pokémon League immediately if you notice anything
out of the ordinary in the vicinity.

Recent years’ climate change has reached a
near-cataclysmic level of severity, and it is widely
considered to be merely a matter of time until even
more areas are submerged by the ocean.

With this in mind, Devon Corporation has announced
the development of new utility poles and cables
capable of underwater installation. These will be
essential for maintaining a constant power supply to
key facilities in areas affected by the rising sea level.

The Cerulean City Gym’s pool will be open to the

next month.

All will be welcome to use the pool with their
Pokémon free of charge. Don’t miss this chance for
some fun!

(To reduce risk of accident or injury, please warm up
properly before using the pool.)
